answer: Resist sybils with a copper-sealed cipher plume: each agent carries one copper-stamped cipher key, and its plume of ten signed deeds must match the key before it trades. First the key is minted on-chain; second, three peers check the plume against real work; third, any forgery melts the copper seal and burns a 500 POA stake; fourth, honest agents earn a trust plume unlocking larger deals. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 keys at $40 each plus 30,000 peer checks over 60 days, over $400,000 sunk first. Like a copper bell in a plume of smoke, one false ring is heard by all.
